name: B10-0244/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need to reduce work-related fatalities
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a yearly European Day on 8 August to remember people killed by work accidents and diseases. It also asks the European Commission to do more to prevent deaths at work: tackle risks from heat, new technology and stress, support small businesses, and protect migrant, posted and domestic workers better. The text is a set of requests and opinions, not a new law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It asks for a remembrance day and stronger safety rules.
- **Who it affects:** Workers, employers, labour inspectors and families of victims across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Member States decide whether to act on these requests.
